summary: The school district emphasizes the importance of reliable internet for modern education, stating that it is crucial for students' learning in both home and school settings. The comment highlights the necessity of uninterrupted internet connectivity for educational purposes, as modern education relies on computers, tablets, and phones for instruction.

claims.argument: Reliable school internet is crucial for our kids these days. When most of their learning is online, both at home and at school, internet connectivity without interruptions is imperative. Modern education uses computers, tablets, phones, etc. in all settings and reliable internet should remain available to all students and schools.
